limitations: Exact finite connected simple undirected graphs on at most four vertices with uniformly located single mutant and standard birth–death update; no higher-order, weighted, death–birth or empirical generalization. title: A sharp four-vertex fitness crossover for edge additions in the birth–death Moran process
